text: Chapter 11: Off to Toram@Eumanos the Forest Dwellers
■Next Mission\nMove from Guardian Forest: Outer Area to\nErva Tronc to start.
The village on the outskirts of the town is said to have\nbeen attacked by a dragon. Join the Eumano soldiers and\nhead to rescue the villagers!
Defeat Zimius, a forest beast that attacks you in\nthe Storage Yard that looks like a maze!
Proceed further into the Storage Yard and defeat the enemy\nthat could be there!
Deep in the Storage Yard, there is an arena\nthat is being remodeled by Junior Dragon Zyvio.\nDefeat Zyvio!
